column3: “Six wings, six wings to one” is rendered “each having six wings.”
“The fullness of all the earth is His glory” is rendered “The whole earth is full of His glory.”
“The house” is rendered “the temple,” and “was filled” as “was filling.”
“I am destroyed” is rendered “I am ruined.”
“Will be removed … will be atoned for” is rendered “is taken away … is forgiven.”
The two verbs are reversed: “understand” and “perceive” change places.
“Make fat … make heavy … seal over” is rendered “insensitive … dull … dim.”
“Will send far away” is rendered in the past, “has removed,” and “will become great” as “are many.”
